claim_states.present: The artifact exists and its declared references resolve.
claim_states.reachable: The default bootstrap, context router, capability catalog, or native adapter provides a concrete path to the artifact.
claim_states.enforced: The real delivery entrypoint exits non-zero for the claimed violation, and a targeted negative probe has demonstrated that failure and subsequent recovery.
claim_states.real_client_verified: The declared client or platform executed its real configured entrypoint successfully; synthetic invocation alone is insufficient.

failure_policy.delivery_checker_exception: A checker invoked as completion, pre-commit, or CI evidence must exit non-zero on internal errors or malformed governed input.
failure_policy.ambient_hook_exception: An ambient client hook may warn and exit zero to preserve repository usability, but the affected claim becomes unverified until repaired.
failure_policy.optional_environment_dependency: A missing local-only or explicitly optional dependency may warn only when the checker names the skipped assertion and the claim is not reported as enforced.

project_result_manifest.coverage: Every required_probe_families id appears exactly once. Applicable probes cannot be not-applicable; pass requires a real entrypoint plus negative and recovery evidence; when a probe requires real-client evidence, missing that evidence is unverified rather than pass.

required_probe_families.applies_when: The framework declares required files or exact local references.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Remove one required exact target while preserving the reference.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The real structure gate exits non-zero and names the missing target plus a repair action.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Restore the target without changing the checker.

required_probe_families.applies_when: Any context, verification, or ownership declaration uses a required glob.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Replace one required glob with a syntactically valid zero-match pattern.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The real structure gate exits non-zero and distinguishes zero matches from an invalid pattern.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Restore a pattern with at least one intended match.
required_probe_families.proves: Required globs cannot silently resolve to an empty set.

required_probe_families.applies_when: A context map or verification profile registry is delivered.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Set the profile registry to null or an empty object, or remove a required profile.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The real structure gate exits non-zero and names the missing minimum profile contract.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Restore the project-evidenced profile set and required fields.
required_probe_families.proves: The routing and verification registries cannot be syntactically valid but semantically empty.

required_probe_families.applies_when: Two or more profiles can be selected by natural-language triggers or overlapping paths.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Run representative repository phrases and paths that should select exactly one profile or an explicitly declared multi-profile set.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The routing probe exits non-zero for an unexpected collision, omission, or ambiguous product-versus-coding-governance match.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Narrow triggers or declare the intended multi-profile result, then replay the same examples.
required_probe_families.expected_recovery: Every example resolves to its expected ordered profile set.
required_probe_families.proves: Routing semantics, not just referenced files, are testable and unambiguous for real project requests.

required_probe_families.applies_when: The framework contains skills, commands, or agents.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Leave a capability file present but remove every bootstrap, router, catalog, and native-adapter path to it.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The real structure gate exits non-zero and names the unreachable capability.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Restore one concrete and valid discovery path.
required_probe_families.proves: A capability cannot be counted as reachable merely because its file exists.

required_probe_families.applies_when: A memory assertion declares an HTTP method and path.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Use the right path under the wrong method and, for compound router conditions, cross-pair methods and paths from different branches.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The real drift gate exits non-zero for both the simple mismatch and any cross-branch false pairing.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Restore the exact supported method-path pair or explicitly declare the project ANY-method convention.
required_probe_families.proves: Method and path are paired rather than independently found in nearby source text.

required_probe_families.applies_when: Memory source front matter declares related_memory or verified_from paths.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Use an empty list, a missing path, or a related memory page absent from the ownership index.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The real drift gate exits non-zero and names the invalid field and target.
required_probe_families.proves: Source evidence paths and memory ownership are parsed and validated, not detected by field-name text alone.

required_probe_families.applies_when: Core code changes require synchronization with module memory pages.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Change one core owner and update only an unrelated memory page.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The real drift or pre-commit entrypoint exits non-zero and names the missing owning memory page.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Update the memory page mapped to every changed core owner.
required_probe_families.proves: Any memory edit is not accepted as a substitute for the corresponding owner update.

required_probe_families.applies_when: A checker is used as delivery, pre-commit, or CI evidence.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Provide malformed governed shape or force a checker read/parse exception without removing an independently required sentinel file.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The delivery entrypoint exits non-zero and identifies the checker error; it must not downgrade the skipped assertion to a successful warning.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Restore valid governed input or repair the checker.
required_probe_families.expected_recovery: The same delivery entrypoint exits zero.
required_probe_families.proves: Explicit delivery evidence fails closed even though ambient hooks may fail open.

required_probe_families.applies_when: A long-running task runtime is delivered.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Inject an invalid task type, illegal history transition, missing conditional metadata, or incomplete required gate set.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The real delivery gate invokes strict doctor behavior and exits non-zero.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Restore a schema-valid task and legal transition history.
required_probe_families.expected_recovery: The same delivery gate exits zero.
required_probe_families.proves: Runtime integrity is enforced by the delivery entrypoint rather than an optional environment setting.

required_probe_families.applies_when: The runtime can return from verifying to implementing and later complete.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Pass or attest all gates, re-enter implementing, return to verifying, and attempt completion without rerunning or reattesting them.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: Completion exits non-zero because receipts belong to an older implementation generation.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Rerun every machine gate and reattest every manual gate for the current generation.
required_probe_families.expected_recovery: Completion succeeds and records the completed generation.
required_probe_families.proves: Old evidence cannot prove a newer implementation.

required_probe_families.applies_when: The runtime exposes both generic transitions and a completion command.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Attempt a generic transition to complete, remove a required gate, or mark a gate passed without evidence, checked time, or current generation.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: Every bypass attempt exits non-zero; terminal tasks with invalid completion evidence remain visible to strict status or doctor.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Use the dedicated completion command with the exact required gate set and complete current evidence.
required_probe_families.proves: Completion has one guarded entrypoint and validates structure, evidence, and freshness atomically.

required_probe_families.applies_when: Post-tool-use events feed a write ledger.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Replay the real client schema for a read carrying file_path and for each write tool shape, including freeform patch and shell writes.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The probe exits non-zero if a read is recorded as a write or a real write is absent from the exact-or-opaque ledger lower bound.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Use client-specific adapters keyed by tool identity and replay the same fixture matrix.
required_probe_families.expected_recovery: Reads produce no write record; every write produces an exact path or opaque marker.
required_probe_families.proves: The ledger classifies actual client operations rather than assuming every path-bearing payload is a write.

required_probe_families.applies_when: A stop hook accepts opaque shell-write markers.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Record only an opaque marker while changing a governed file in a temporary Git checkout.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The real Stop entrypoint resolves the changed path and blocks with the proportional obligations.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Satisfy the current obligations or restore the worktree.
required_probe_families.expected_recovery: The same Stop entrypoint allows completion when no current obligations remain.
required_probe_families.proves: Version-control changes are merged with the ledger, or the hook reports enforcement unverified when version control is unavailable.

required_probe_families.applies_when: A Stop hook blocks completion until gates or knowledge synchronization are satisfied.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Write governed code and invoke the real Stop entrypoint before verification.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: Stop exits non-zero and prints exact obligations.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Run the required gates, synchronize the owning memory, persist a receipt bound to the current write generation or change fingerprint, and invoke Stop again.
required_probe_families.expected_recovery: The second Stop exits zero without using ack or a kill switch.
required_probe_families.proves: The hook has a normal write-block-verify-allow success path rather than an endless block loop.

required_probe_families.applies_when: Any hard enforcement entrypoint supports an audited ack.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Create one ack and invoke the owning enforcement entrypoint twice against the same or a changed change set.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: Exactly one invocation may consume the ack; the second blocks. A changed fingerprint never reuses the first ack.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Create a new reasoned ack explicitly scoped to the new enforcement entrypoint and change fingerprint.
required_probe_families.expected_recovery: That entrypoint consumes it once and records the reason.
required_probe_families.proves: single_use is behavior enforced atomically, not a descriptive JSON field.

required_probe_families.applies_when: A repository pre-commit hook is claimed installed or enforced.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Invoke the tracked pre-commit entrypoint in a temporary Git checkout with a deterministic failing governance condition.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The hook entrypoint exits non-zero; calling only an underlying checker does not satisfy this probe.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Repair the condition and invoke the same tracked hook entrypoint again.
required_probe_families.expected_recovery: The hook exits zero and any scoped ack or receipt has the documented lifecycle.
required_probe_families.proves: Installed, entrypoint-replayed, and change-sync-enforced are reported as separate evidence states.

required_probe_families.applies_when: A complete framework delivers L11 improvement candidates or periodic health checks.
required_probe_families.negative_case: Remove an improvement candidate owner or review date, omit last or next health-check metadata, or use an unknown lifecycle status.
required_probe_families.expected_failure: The real framework gate exits non-zero and names the missing or invalid machine-readable lifecycle field; facts that cannot be rechecked remain unverified rather than silently current.
required_probe_families.recovery_case: Restore an accountable owner, review date, allowed status, and last and next health-check metadata, then replay the same gate.
required_probe_families.expected_recovery: The framework gate exits zero and the candidate remains queryable as an owned queue item rather than a prose checkbox.
required_probe_families.proves: L11 has accountable maintenance state and a scheduled revalidation loop.
